response:
I'm so sorry for the loss of your grandpa. Grief is incredibly heavy, and it's completely understandable that you're struggling right now. You deserve support during this time.

There are free and low-cost options available. Many hospice organizations offer free bereavement support groups and counseling to anyone in the community, even if your grandpa wasn't under their care. You can also call 211 (available in many areas) to be connected with local grief resources. NAMI (National Alliance on Mental Illness) offers free peer support, and faith communities often have grief groups open to anyone regardless of membership. Online communities like GriefShare can also help you feel less alone. If you're in the U.S., you can call or text 988 anytime for emotional support at no cost.

Please be gentle with yourself—there's no timeline for grief, and reaching out for help is a meaningful step. You don't have to carry this alone.
